Tom, saw Playground now has 300,000-plus directors, teachers, and families on the platform.

Growth at that scale usually means more in-market programs than the team can personally touch before reps can work them, and that is exactly where pipeline goes cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Playground off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Playground needs to close that gap, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
